title: SKP Processor
description: Processor replicas. service_name is a real multi-select here: a processor takes its name and version from its database row via the two-stage boot, so different images carry different identities.

panels.title: Consuming
panels.description:
0 means no consumer tag on at least one queue -- nothing is listening. No other signal answers this.

Restricted to replicas that have reported in the last 40s: a dead replica's gauge is held at its last value by the collector and by Prometheus's lookback, so an unrestricted min() reads the posture of processes that no longer exist.

panels.title: L2 gate
panels.description: The single best answer to 'why did the pipeline stop'. 0 means the gate is shut and deliveries are being requeued.

panels.title: Identity ready
panels.description: 0 means the pod is up and waiting for a processor row whose SourceHash matches its image. Running / NotReady with 0 restarts is the designed behaviour, not a crash loop -- this is the metric that makes that legible.

panels.title: Duplicates suppressed
panels.description: Deliveries acked having done no work, because the entry was already absent. The primary idempotence mechanism; invisible under disposition=acked. Rare is fine, frequent is a question.

targets.expr: ((sum(increase(pipeline_duplicate_suppressed_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",processorId=~"$processorId"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) > (sum(max_over_time(pipeline_duplicate_suppressed_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",processorId=~"$processorId"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) or (sum(max_over_time(pipeline_duplicate_suppressed_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",processorId=~"$processorId"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Not acked
panels.description:
Deliveries the consumer refused or sent back, COUNTED over the visible range. Drill into 'reason' on the pipeline tier for why.

Counted rather than rated. As a rate this read 0.00 through every scenario in the chaos suite: the rate window is 240s here, so the single parked delivery the broker outage produced was 1/240 = 0.004, which rounds to nothing at any sane precision.

targets.expr: ((sum(increase(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",processorId=~"$processorId",disposition=~"requeued|parked"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) > (sum(max_over_time(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",processorId=~"$processorId",disposition=~"requeued|parked"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) or (sum(max_over_time(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",processorId=~"$processorId",disposition=~"requeued|parked"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Ack lost
panels.description: The silent case: the handler ran to completion but the broker never heard the ack, so it will redeliver. Cause is on the channel-resets panel. Counted over the range, for the reason 'Not acked' gives.

targets.expr: ((sum(increase(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",processorId=~"$processorId",disposition="acked",landed="false"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) > (sum(max_over_time(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",processorId=~"$processorId",disposition="acked",landed="false"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) or (sum(max_over_time(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",processorId=~"$processorId",disposition="acked",landed="false"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Egress faults
panels.description:
unroutable = the queue is not declared. transient = the broker is unreachable. Opposite remedies; this is the only signal that separates them.

Counted over the range. Scaling the broker to zero for sixty seconds produced exactly two transient publishes; as a rate they were 0.00 on every board and the only trace of them anywhere was a new legend entry on the produced-by-outcome timeseries.

targets.expr: ((sum(increase(pipeline_messages_produced_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",processorId=~"$processorId",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) > (sum(max_over_time(pipeline_messages_produced_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",processorId=~"$processorId",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) or (sum(max_over_time(pipeline_messages_produced_total{service_name=~"$service_name",service_version=~"$service_version",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",processorId=~"$processorId",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Channel resets
panels.description: Channel churn over the visible range. The cause of ack loss.

panels.title: Produced by type and outcome
panels.description: Egress. outcome != accepted is a fault.

panels.title: Consumed by type and disposition
panels.description: Ingress. Exactly one increment per delivery, on every exit path of the consumer.

panels.title: Produce duration p95 / p99
panels.description:
A real broker round-trip to publisher confirmation, not the time to write a frame.

The mean rides alongside the quantiles deliberately. It comes from sum/count and so is independent of bucket boundaries -- if it ever diverges wildly from p50, the ladder has stopped fitting the data. That is exactly how the millisecond-ladder defect was caught: p95 read 4.9s while the mean read 15ms.

panels.title: Consumer inflight by queue
panels.description: Deliveries inside a handler. PrefetchCount is 1, so a sustained 1 is saturation -- the threshold line marks it.

panels.title: Channel resets by reason
panels.description: shutdown, recovered, reopened. Each renumbers delivery tags and is what makes landed=false possible.

panels.title: Consuming by queue
panels.description:
Per-queue view of the verdict stat. A queue reading 0 while the others read 1 is one wedged consumer, not an outage.

A queue whose LINE STOPS is a replica that has gone away: the series is restricted to replicas reporting inside 40s, so a departure ends the line instead of freezing it at 1.

Unfilled on purpose: the orchestrator has five queues, all sitting at 1 in health, and five filled areas stacked on one line render as a single opaque block in which a dip is invisible.

panels.title: Process duration p95 / p99 by outcome
panels.description:
The author's own transform -- the only span here whose length is somebody's implementation rather than this framework's constant cost. returned vs faulted keeps a slow success and a slow failure from averaging into a number describing neither.

The mean rides alongside the quantiles as a bucket-independent cross-check, for the same reason it does on the produce-duration panel.

panels.title: Identity ready by replica
panels.description:
One line per replica that is still reporting.

Unrestricted, this panel GAINS series during a rollout: the departed replicas are held by the collector and Prometheus while their replacements start exporting, so two live processors rendered as four lines all sitting at 1. A line that ends is a replica that left.

panels.title: Duplicate suppression rate
panels.description: Flat zero is healthy and is drawn, not left empty.

panels.title: Replica fan-out
panels.description: Replicas share one queue, so the broker round-robins. A replica sitting near zero while the others work is consuming nothing despite looking healthy.

panels.title: Thread-pool queue length
panels.description: Explains consumption stalling while the gate is open and the consumer still reports consuming=1: callbacks are starved, not blocked.

panels.title: GC pause time
panels.description: Seconds of GC pause per second. Explains duration p99 spikes with no broker or dependency fault.

panels.title: Exception rate
panels.description: Correlates with rising parked / refused dispositions and with faulted process outcomes.

panels.title: Process restarts
panels.description: A monotonic counter going backwards means the process is new. The one signal that explains a simultaneous gap in every other series.
